description: Phase 2 corpus: the prepared Bangla Wikipedia of the public ban-dataset-collection (Kala bnwiki-prose-v1 cleaning, bangla-dh-text-v1 normalization, paragraph deduplication, document-level split). The BanLemma second-domain check of the original run is not public data and is not part of this repository; the news cross-check (data/crosscheck-v1.json) is the second domain.
deduplication: exact paragraph-level across the whole corpus in source order (the first occurrence is kept); documents left empty are dropped (done when the collection was prepared)

frequency_weights.description: alpha_d of RESEARCH_SPEC 5.2 for the optimization frequencies. D4 default: Wikipedia train only; BanLemma is a second-domain held-out check.
